About Company

Tonbo Imaging India Limited was originally incorporated in 2003 and is a global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer that designs, develops and manufactures sensing, processing, communication and guidance systems for surveillance, reconnaissance, targeting and control.

The company has developed a diversified product portfolio including thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, hand-held thermal imaging binoculars, targeting systems, missile seekers, fire control systems and missile guidance systems to enable autonomy on the battlefield. With over 28,000 systems deployed across 24 countries as of June 30, 2026, the company offers field-proven electro-optic products free from ITAR export restrictions.

The company owns 100% of its intellectual property since Fiscal 2024, ranging from optics to embedded software and electronics, and operates an asset-light business model where core design and IP are developed in-house while manufacturing is outsourced to certified electronics manufacturing services partners.

Key Product Segments

  • Tactical systems - electro-optical sights for dismounted soldiers
  • Platform systems - stabilized multi-sensor gimbals and EO/IR payloads for land, air and naval platforms
  • Directed energy systems - RF-based and jet-powered systems for neutralising aerial and ground threats

The company supplies products under India's IDDM framework and serves both domestic and international customers including global militaries, law enforcement and homeland security agencies, positioning itself as a leading provider of indigenous defence electronics technology.

Strengths

Proprietary Defence Technologies: The company owns 100% of its intellectual property since Fiscal 2024, spanning optics, embedded software and electronics including proprietary video engines, AI-accelerated image processing and sub-5 µrad multi-axis gimbal stabilization, enabling full control over its technology roadmap.

Asset-Light R&D Driven Model: The company operates an asset-light business model with in-house core design and IP development, outsourcing manufacturing to certified EMS partners, employing 130 engineers at its Bengaluru R&D centre as of June 30, 2026.

Global Acceptability as Defence OEM: The company is a global defence electronics OEM with products sold across EU, US and Israel, and was the largest manufacturer by sales value of thermal imaging systems to Indian government and defence agencies between April 2024 and March 2026.

Risk Factors

Cyclical, Tender-Based Revenue: The company's business is cyclical due to government budget cycles and tender-based procurement, resulting in poor revenue visibility; revenue from operations declined 22.69% in Fiscal 2026 due to delays in execution of international orders arising from the West Asia conflict.

Customer Concentration Risk: Despite short-term, non-recurring tender-based contracts, top 5 customers contributed 53.03% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026, and loss of key customers or non-renewal of orders could adversely affect business and financial condition.

Supplier Concentration Risk: The company's top ten suppliers contributed 164.00%, 68.77%, 35.46% and 67.49% of total expenses in the three months ended June 30, 2026 and Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024 respectively, with no long-term contracts in place with these suppliers.
